intentAndPurpose.intent: A visual mark that identifies and reinforces brand identity throughout the interface. Transparent size container — the SVG content controls its own shape and colors. Inside a BrandProvider, `<Logo alt="…" />` renders the active brand's logo automatically; pass children / svgContent / src only to override it.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible name for the brand mark. Meaningful text exposes an image/link/button name; `""` or whitespace-only values hide decorative logos from assistive tech.

props.name: children
props.description: Logo content as React node (SVG element, icon, etc.) — highest priority

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name

props.name: customSize
props.description: Custom size in pixels (only when size='custom')

props.name: data-testid
props.description: QA / Playwright hook — forwarded to the root element

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction and reduces opacity. Default: false

props.name: fallback
props.description: Fallback content when src fails to load

props.name: href
props.description: Navigation target when interactive (renders `<a>`).

props.name: interactive
props.description: When true, logo is interactive (link or button). Default: false. Requires meaningful `alt` plus `href` or `onClick`/`onPress`.

props.name: material
props.description: Metallic material paint for inline SVG content. Raster src logos are unchanged.

props.name: materialGradientAngle
props.description: Gradient direction angle used by the metallic SVG paint server. Defaults to 135.

props.name: materialGradientType
props.description: Gradient style used by the metallic SVG paint server. Defaults to linear.

props.name: materialTarget
props.description: SVG paint channels that receive the metallic material. Default: fill-stroke

props.name: onClick
props.description: Web alias for `onPress`.

props.name: onError
props.description: Image error callback (src mode only)

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Image load callback (src mode only)

props.name: onPress
props.description: Press handler when interactive without `href` (renders `<button>`).

props.name: size
props.description: Size preset. Default: 'm'

props.name: src
props.description: Image source URL for raster/external logos

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles

props.name: svgContent
props.description: Raw SVG markup string (e.g., from Convex brand.logoSvg)

props.name: variant
props.description: Circular mark or full rectangular wordmark. Default: 'mark'
